description: Manages and provides analytical insights and trends related to contacts, their activities, engagement, and distribution.

endpoints.name: GetMostActiveContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves contacts with the highest interaction activity within a specified timeframe and based on a given metric.
example_uses: Show me the top 5 most active contacts in the last 90 days based on interactions.
Who are the most active contacts this month?
List the contacts with the most document views in the last year.
endpoints.when_to_use: To identify and analyze the most engaged contacts based on their activity.

endpoints.name: GetContactsByGeographicRegion
endpoints.description: Retrieves the distribution of contacts across different geographic regions, grouped by country or other specified criteria.
example_uses: Show me the contact distribution by country.
How many contacts are there in each region, grouped by city?
List regions with at least 10 contacts.
endpoints.when_to_use: To understand the geographical spread of contacts and identify regional concentrations.

endpoints.name: GetContactEngagementTrends
endpoints.description: Retrieves trends in contact engagement over time, based on specified periods and metrics.
example_uses: Show me the monthly contact engagement trends for the last 12 months.
What are the quarterly engagement trends based on interactions?
Analyze contact engagement trends over the past two years.
endpoints.when_to_use: To monitor and analyze how contact engagement changes over time.

endpoints.name: GetContactsByInteractionType
endpoints.description: Retrieves contacts based on specific interaction types within a given date range.
example_uses: Show me contacts who had 'meeting' interactions last month.
List contacts involved in 'email' interactions between January and March.
Find contacts with any interaction type in the last week.
endpoints.when_to_use: To filter contacts by the nature of their interactions and specific timeframes.

endpoints.name: GetContactsByPartner
endpoints.description: Retrieves the distribution of contacts associated with different partners.
example_uses: Show me the number of contacts per partner.
List partners with at least 5 contacts.
Include inactive partners when showing contact distribution.
endpoints.when_to_use: To understand how contacts are distributed among various partners.

endpoints.name: GetRecentlyActiveContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves contacts who have been recently active within a specified number of days.
example_uses: Show me the 10 most recently active contacts in the last 7 days.
Who are the contacts active in the last 30 days, sorted by their last interaction?
List recently active contacts.
endpoints.when_to_use: To quickly identify contacts who have shown recent activity.

endpoints.name: GetContactsByJobTitle
endpoints.description: Retrieves contact activity grouped by job titles.
example_uses: Show me contacts grouped by their job titles.
List job titles with at least 5 contacts.
Include interaction counts when grouping contacts by job title.
endpoints.when_to_use: To analyze contact distribution and activity based on their professional roles.

endpoints.name: GetContactGrowthTrends
endpoints.description: Retrieves trends in contact growth over time.
example_uses: Show me the monthly contact growth trends for the last year.
What is the quarterly contact growth trend?
Analyze contact growth over the past 6 months.
endpoints.when_to_use: To monitor and analyze the rate of new contact acquisition over time.

endpoints.name: GetContactsWithMostDocuments
endpoints.description: Retrieves contacts who have the most associated documents within a specified date range.
example_uses: Show me the top 5 contacts with the most documents.
List contacts with the most documents uploaded last quarter.
Find contacts with the highest number of documents between specific dates.
endpoints.when_to_use: To identify contacts who are heavily involved in document exchange or creation.
